newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste says seeks share issue authorisation.
newsitem.headline: Neste says seeks share issue authorisation.

text.p: Finnish state-controlled oil and chemicals group Neste Oy said in a statement on Thursday it was seeking authorisation from the annual general meeting to raise the share capital by 98.5 million markka, or 10 percent.
Neste's board would be authorised for one year from the April 8 annual general meeting to issue convertible bonds or new shares and set the subscription price and other terms, the company said.
The Finnish state owns 83.5 percent of Neste and has been authorised by parliament to cut the holding to 50.1 percent.
